label: Chat
stop.confirm: End this chat? Its program closes; its conversation stays with the account.
picker.title: Open a chat
picker.subtitle: Your own Claude Code or Codex, in a terminal over the screen, working in this browser alone. It runs as its maker publishes it, and you sign in there. Its screenshots go to that account’s provider, and can show what you did in this session.
empty: No accounts yet. Add one, one for each login you want to use.
remove.confirm: Remove {name}? Its login, its conversations and its files on this server go too.
add.name: Account name
replaced: This chat is open in another window.
lost: The terminal lost its connection. The program is still running.
